article.headline: Williamson, Pelicans to host Cunningham and the Pistons
article.description: Detroit Pistons (9-4, third in the Eastern Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (5-10, 12th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Williamson, Pelicans to host Cunningham and the Pistons
article.linkText: Williamson, Pelicans to host Cunningham and the Pistons
article.story: Detroit Pistons (9-4, third in the Eastern Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (5-10, 12th in the Western Conference) New Orleans; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EST LINE: Pistons -8.5; over/under is 229.5 BOTTOM LINE: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Detroit Pistons in non-conference play. The Pelicans are 4-6 on their home court. New Orleans is the top team in the Western Conference with 54.8 points in the paint led by Zion Williamson averaging 13.7. The Pistons have gone 6-2 away from home. Detroit ranks seventh in the Eastern Conference with 44.3 rebounds per game led by Ausar Thompson averaging 8.7. The 115.8 points per game the Pelicans score are 6.9 more points than the Pistons allow (108.9). The Pistons average 12.9 made 3-pointers per game this season, 0.4 fewer makes per game than the Pelicans give up. TOP PERFORMERS: Williamson is scoring 21.5 points per game with 5.3 rebounds and 2.6 assists for the Pelicans. Saddiq Bey is averaging 18.8 points and 4.7 rebounds while shooting 46.4% over the last 10 games. Cade Cunningham is averaging 25.8 points, 5.2 rebounds and 7.8 assists for the Pistons. Daniss Jenkins is averaging 2.3 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Pelicans: 4-6, averaging 114.0 points, 41.7 rebounds, 23.9 assists, 8.2 steals and 5.4 blocks per game while shooting 44.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 123.5 points per game. Pistons: 6-4, averaging 113.8 points, 42.0 rebounds, 27.7 assists, 10.4 steals and 5.8 blocks per game while shooting 46.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.9 points. INJURIES: Pelicans: Bryce McGowens: day to day (elbow), Dejounte Murray: day to day (ankle), Bennedict Mathurin: day to day (plantar), Trendon Watford: day to day (ankle), Trey Murphy III: day to day (knee). Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Ronald Holland II: day to day (knee), Taurean Prince: day to day (knee), Duncan Robinson: out (quadriceps), Isaiah Joe: day to day (hip). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.

articles.description: — Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 points and forced overtime on his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds left in regulation before the Los Angeles Lakers finished off their ninth consecutive victory, 118-114 over the Charlotte Hornets on Tuesday night.
